ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Low ratio of high-intensity to low-intensity pixels; the visible ventral surface is predominantly low-intensity (black) with sparse high-intensity (white/light grey) focal points comprising less than 5% of the total surface area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Primary surface consists of two large, dark contiguous regions. High-contrast white focal spots are mapped as follows: a distinct circular ring-shaped feature on the medial-lateral region of the left lobe, and scattered stippling/mottling concentrated along the lower interior margins near the notch and trailing edges.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: V-shaped depression with an observable aperture of approximately 75-85 degrees; the vertex is partially occluded by water turbulence (spray), limiting precise depth calculation.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency serration along the continuous trailing boundary; peaks and valleys range from 3 to 12 pixels in amplitude, with higher amplitude irregularity observed near the distal tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave sweep trajectory along the trailing edge leading to acuminate distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Distinct high-contrast circular ring (approximately 15-20 pixels in diameter) on the left lobe; high-intensity irregular clusters consistent with barnacle colonization are located at the extreme distal tips of both lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle colonization present on the lateral tips of both lobes, exhibiting high-intensity, multi-tonal (white/tan) calcified structures.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique white circular ring-mark located on the mid-section of the left lobe ventral surface.
